sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def read_state():
    rows=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def cluster(ch, r0, r1, c0=0, c1=64):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if rows[r][c]==ch]
        if not pts: return None
        rs=[x[0] for x in pts]; cs=[x[1] for x in pts]
        return ((min(rs)+max(rs))//2,(min(cs)+max(cs))//2,len(pts))
    return {'ring':cluster('p',15,28),'ball':cluster('p',40,64),
            'G':cluster('G',40,64),'cursor':cluster('W',25,64,15,63)}
print("before:", read_state())
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':21,'col':39}])
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
print("after :", read_state())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def read_state():
    rows=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def cluster(ch, r0, r1, c0=0, c1=64):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if rows[r][c]==ch]
        if not pts: return None
        rs=[x[0] for x in pts]; cs=[x[1] for x in pts]
        return ((min(rs)+max(rs))//2,(min(cs)+max(cs))//2,len(pts))
    return {'ring':cluster('p',15,28),'ball':cluster('p',40,64),
            'G':cluster('G',40,64),'cursor':cluster('W',25,64,15,63)}
